categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in two segments: the automotive parts manufacturing division producing water pumps, oil pumps, auto parts, and aluminum cylinder heads for engines and transmissions; and the battery division producing primary batteries (alkaline, manganese), nickel-hydrogen, lithium-ion, automotive starter batteries, industrial and military battery packs. Additionally, the company has a real estate leasing business segment.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced manufacturing and quality control technologies for automotive engine and transmission components, including specialized casting and machining processes. In the battery segment, it employs strict raw material selection and quality management systems to produce various battery types, including lithium-ion and nickel-hydrogen batteries, with ongoing R&D in electric water pumps, oil pumps, and battery packs for personal mobility and electric vehicles.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major domestic automotive manufacturers such as Hyundai Motor, Kia Motors, Hyundai Mobis, and other parts suppliers. The battery division serves consumer electronics, industrial, military sectors, and personal mobility markets. The company also engages in real estate leasing, with apartment sales contributing significantly to revenue.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in South Korea with manufacturing facilities in Asan and Gumi. It serves domestic OEMs and exports approximately 30% of its automotive parts. The battery business also targets domestic and international markets, including global OEMs for automotive components.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream segment of the automotive supply chain as a parts manufacturer supplying directly to OEMs. In the battery sector, it functions as a manufacturer and supplier of primary and secondary batteries, serving both B2B and B2C markets.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include securing future capabilities in electric vehicle and hydrogen fuel cell components, focusing on electronic water and oil pumps, and expanding into electric mobility battery packs. R&D efforts emphasize cost competitiveness, scale economies, and advanced technology development in collaboration with OEMs, with increased investment in research personnel and innovation in battery technologies.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of automotive parts and batteries. The company also earns income from real estate leasing and apartment sales. Export sales constitute about 30% of total revenue, with the remainder from domestic sales to OEMs and retail channels.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors in automotive parts include GMB Korea and Myunghwa Industry. While the company’s total sales are lower than these competitors, it holds a strong position in key product lines like water pumps and oil pumps. In the battery sector, the company differentiates itself through brand recognition, quality control, and diversified product offerings, competing with domestic and international battery manufacturers.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2023, the company reported consolidated revenues of approximately 202.7 billion KRW, a 48.2% increase from the previous year, with operating profit rising 176.5%. Total assets stood at about 103.3 billion KRW, down 30.9%, and liabilities decreased by 55.5%. The company shows a positive growth trajectory with expanding sales in automotive and battery segments and increased operating profitability.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality manufacturing with strict raw material selection and quality management, offering technologically advanced automotive components and specialized batteries. Its competitive edge lies in long-standing OEM relationships, continuous innovation in electric and hybrid vehicle components, and a unique domestic battery brand recognized for reliability and performance across diverse applications.
